connectorLimitations: The connector response is bounded to 20,480 bytes, so the deterministic snapshot was assembled from ordered read-only slices.
The Plugin API exposes local variable, style, binding, mode, publishing, and remote metadata; the visible historical inventory board is not machine authority.
Figma text styles expose the available Sofia Sans face; the engineering body-weight target of 450 remains a frontend implementation contract.
Assistive-technology, keyboard, Dialog, and Drawer runtime behavior cannot be proven by token extraction.
